_comment: Each slug below was verified live (curl'd the actual Greenhouse/Lever API) before being added, and had at least one real MuleSoft-related posting at verification time - unlike the big Indian IT-services firms (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, Capgemini), which don't run Greenhouse or Lever at all (guessed slugs 404'd or hit unrelated companies with the same slug). Range: innovationsolved/greenirony are small MuleSoft-focused boutique consultancies (startup-scale); ioconnectservices.com/ubiminds are small-to-mid integration/staffing shops; ciandt is a global IT consultancy (MNC-scale); twilio/yext/monsterenergy/gurobioptimization are recognizable product companies that occasionally post MuleSoft-adjacent integration roles. Add more the same way: open a company's real careers page, confirm the URL contains 'greenhouse.io' or 'jobs.lever.co', copy the slug in.
